reserves.n: All coal, not split thermal/metallurgical. EIA estimates last revised in 2022.

exports.n: Thermal coal only (EIA: all coal minus metallurgical coal). Not the basis of the seaborne figure, which is all coal.

seaborne.n: All coal, thermal and metallurgical: customs codes do not separate them, so this is not comparable with the thermal-only exports figure. Customs data give 1,609 Mt of all-coal trade by all modes in 2024; EIA puts world exports of all coal at 1,533 Mt in 2024. Seaborne subset of BACI flows (coal) under the atlas's mode rule (method in the About window): trade by sea, or by sea through a foreign port for a landlocked country; 95.1 Mt that move both by sea and overland (split not known) are not in it; all coal (thermal and metallurgical).
